name: Magyarszombatfa (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and light grey at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Magyarszombatfa (a red and yellow shield with a castle tower and a figure) above the name MAGYARSZOMBATFA in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
